scope: One supported composition of existing personality, needs, real feedback learning, prediction, receding planning and persistence. No new AI mechanisms.

milestones.exit: All registered worlds complete, replay audited, original inequalities met, all losses and personality differences reviewed; no substitution of an easier baseline.
One documented composition, explicit model/goal ownership, factual versus simulated feedback isolation, retry semantics, settings-bound save/restore and host world boundary tested.
Required independent confirmation of any behavior-changing fix, supported OS/Python regression, installable package examples without research tools; source provenance matches evaluated behavior.
All quality and integration requirements met; package/version/release notes identify supported scope and known limits.
Only release blockers after target date. Never label failing or incompletely verified code stable.

current_work.change: Bind RecedingOwner persistence to expected planning settings, owner settings and public world boundary. Restore a new instance without mutating the live owner.
remaining: Select adopted composition only after independent40 audit
Move any selected research orchestration into the package with parity evidence
Audit complete actual feedback and restoration on the final supported composition
Run final independent confirmation if changes alter decisions

scheduling: No recurring automation. Existing finite evaluation continues; code changes and result review require an active agent execution.
